nodes.text: Principles of trial interpretation: massive sample sizes can render minuscule clinical differences statistically significant
Evaluate p-value: p = 0.047 confirms statistical significance (< 0.05) but does not establish clinical importance
Calculate absolute risk reduction (ARR): ARR = 0.044 - 0.042 = 0.002 (0.2% absolute reduction in fracture risk)
Calculate NNT: NNT = 1 / 0.002 = 500 patients treated to prevent 1 fracture
Balance benefit against harm: compare NNT of 500 with high adverse discontinuation rate (15.5% vs 12.0% in placebo)

algorithm.title: Randomized clinical trial validity and analytic strategies

nodes.text: Randomized clinical trials: randomization balances known and unknown confounding variables across comparison groups
Intention-to-treat (ITT) analysis: analyze all patients in assigned randomized groups regardless of protocol deviations or dropout
Per-protocol analysis: analyzes only participants completing intervention as planned, risking severe attrition bias
**Excluding perioperative surgical deaths:** severely violates ITT and falsely inflates surgical treatment efficacy
As-treated analysis: categorizes patients by intervention received, eliminating benefits of baseline randomization
Sensitivity analyses: report both ITT and per-protocol results to assess robustness of findings

algorithm.title: Evaluation and management of severe frostbite

nodes.text: Recognize severe frostbite: freezing cold injury with hemorrhagic blisters, distal pallor, and persistent anesthesia
Immediate rewarming: rapid immersion in circulating warm water (40-42°C) for 15-30 minutes until thawed
Post-thaw wound care: apply topical aloe vera, keep clean and dry, elevate limbs, and provide parenteral analgesia
Avoid premature surgery: allow weeks to months for definitive dry gangrene demarcation before amputation
**Severe limb-threatening frostbite within 24 hours of thaw:** evaluate for IV or intra-arterial thrombolysis (tPA)
Patient communication: explain that injury is severe but full extent of tissue loss cannot be determined initially

algorithm.title: Interpretation of meta-analyses and forest plots

nodes.text: Forest plot orientation: vertical line represents null hypothesis (relative risk = 1.0; risk difference = 0)
Evaluate individual trial estimates: horizontal bars represent 95% confidence intervals; crossing null indicates p ≥ 0.05
Evaluate pooled summary estimate: diamond width represents pooled 95% CI; touching or crossing null denotes nonsignificance
Interpretation of nonsignificant result: observed differences may be due to random chance rather than true effect
**Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence:** failure to reject null does not prove equivalence to placebo
Assess heterogeneity: inspect Chi-squared test and I-squared statistic for inconsistency across included trials
